QuestInfo.name: The Surprise Gift
QuestInfo.0: You delivered 10 Boogies' gift to Dances with Balrog. What was it? Ask him about it.
QuestInfo.1: The gift exploded into Smiling Ghost Stumps! Is 10 Boogies insane, or just criminally stupid? Eliminate all of the Smiling Ghost Stumps.
QuestInfo.2: So...Blackbull booby-trapped the gift 10 Boogie had. Dances with Balrog doesn't seem to mind, but 10 Boogies should know how badly she was fooled.

0.0: Do you want to know what's inside? Heh. Let us open it together, then...

1.0: Excellent! I see your training has really paid off. Now...I assume this is the work of Blackbull. 10 Boogies is not smar-I mean, 10 Boogies is far too kind and innocent to do such a thing. But Blackbull...he's a jerk.

npc.0: Do you wish to know what is inside the gift you brought from 10 Boogies? Abandon the quest and accept it again.
